camera_motion_anchor.source: first deterministic selected row in hash-bound estimated inventory

camera_motion_trace.basis: shots 6-7 audit direct recorded camera_optical poses without applying a presentation guide; shots 8-12 apply a C3 presentation guide fit to the declared sampling interval; exact interpolation-knot dependencies are derived from the hash-bound trajectory; timestamped camera optical transforms are derived from the bound sensor artifact; both remain independent of rendered scan cutoff

selective_current_scan_goal.representation: feature-specific selections from timestamped raw PointCloud2 returns
selective_current_scan_goal.spatial_registration: recorded camera/LiDAR calibration and estimated map-frame pose interpolation
selective_current_scan_goal.temporal_policy: current scans or bounded past-only scan history; future scans are rejected

inventory.semantics: ground-truth-free LiDAR-localized estimated centers; no estimated extents

rgb_video.semantics: recorded RGB from the same capture

trajectory.semantics: estimated SLAM trajectory in map frame

storyboard_exclusion_basis: all render inputs are enumerated and hashed; storyboard paths and known reference hashes are rejected before decode
